# Django Patterns

Curated by Skill Harbor: a patterns skill for building Django applications that survive production. It prescribes a split-settings project layout (base, development, production, test), model design with proper indexes and constraints, custom QuerySets and managers to kill N+1 queries before they start, and Django REST Framework patterns for serializers, viewsets, permissions, filtering, and custom actions. A service-layer pattern keeps business logic out of views, while caching strategies (view-level, template fragments, low-level cache API), signals, and custom middleware cover the operational side. Performance guidance includes select_related and prefetch_related, database indexing, and bulk operations. By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: pure guidance, nothing to install; production settings snippets assume you manage secrets through environment variables, never hardcode them. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
